parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application. The value must be the same as that of the live stream that you want to relay. View AppName on the [Stream Management](t2019924.xdita#).

parameters.name: DstUrl
parameters.description: The third-party URL to which the live stream is relayed.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream. View StreamName on the [Stream Management](t2019924.xdita#) page.
